titles: Build a 2-Minute AI CLI to Summarize Meeting Notes
Summarize Markdown Meeting Notes With Chat Completions
Add Friendly Error Handling to Your AI Notes Tool
publish.description: In this short video you will build a tiny command line tool that summarizes plain markdown meeting notes with an AI model. You will install the OpenAI client, store the key in a .env file, call the chat completions endpoint, and add a friendly error handler for missing files. The demo runs on a real weekly sync and finishes in about four seconds.
highlights: Start from plain markdown weekly sync notes
Install packages and store API key in .env
Call chat completions to print summary and actions
Add friendly handler for missing file errors
